import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.ntru_e2e.bootstrap import COMMIT,HERE,apply_recorded_patch
def run(label,argv,cwd=None,timeout=None,env_update=None):
    return subprocess.check_output(argv,cwd=cwd,timeout=timeout,text=True,env=dict(os.environ,**(env_update or {})),stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
patch=HERE/'provenance'/'upstream_source.patch'
original=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(HERE/'.deps'/'g6k_hybrid'),'show',COMMIT+':kernel/hash_table.inl'])
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ntru-recorded-patch-check-') as temporary:
    source=Path(temporary)
    target=source/'kernel'/'hash_table.inl'
    target.parent.mkdir()
    target.write_bytes(original)
    target.chmod(0o755)
    run('init',['git','init','--quiet'],source)
    run('add',['git','add','kernel/hash_table.inl'],source)
    run('commit',['git','-c','user.name=NTRU bootstrap check','-c','user.email=bootstrap@example.invalid','commit','--quiet','-m','Pinned upstream blob'],source)
    first=apply_recorded_patch(source,patch,run)
    second=apply_recorded_patch(source,patch,run)
    assert first=='applied' and second=='already_applied'
    print(json.dumps({'upstream_commit':COMMIT,'patch_sha256':hashlib.sha256(patch.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'application':first,'repeat':second,'upstream_blob_sha256':hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(),'patched_blob_sha256':hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'checkout':'temporary copy only; existing .deps read using git show'},indent=2))
